title: evaluation-decision
description: Output of the evaluate skill: the reuse/adapt/build decision for a need, with the candidates surveyed (show your work).

scope.description: the scope of the need (command, domain, doc, ...)

target.description: the capability to reuse/adapt (name or path); absent for build

delta.description: for adapt: the specific changes, usually 'add a <scope> contract' or a small edit

adapt_mode.description: for adapt: edit the target in place, or fork a renamed v2 copy. Must be by-copy when the target is load-bearing.

rationale.description: why this decision, in a line or two

candidates.description: every library capability surveyed and its fit (the evidence for the decision)

allOf.$comment: reuse and adapt must name the target capability
adapt must declare its delta and its mode (in-place vs by-copy)
